message: 胸騒ぎの交錯

name: Nanaka
message: 「Morning!!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Mornin'」

name: Eddie
message: 「'Sup」

name: Synn
message: 「Mornin' there」

name: Azel
message: 「Hey」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, morning--」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, Azel. That's rare. You're actually the one calling out to me」

name: Azel
message: 「That doesn't matter. More importantly, you--」

name: Synn
message: 「Hm?」

name: Azel
message: 「...N-No. Never mind」

name: Synn
message: 「Saying it like that only makes me more curious」

name: Azel
message: 「I said it's nothing\s01」

name: Synn
message: 「Come on, just tell me what it is」

name: Eddie
message: 「Hey. Your fly's wide open」

name: Synn
message: 「Wha!? C-Could it be... this is what Azel wanted to tell me?」

name: Azel
message: 「...Y-Yeah, that's it」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Azel-chan, that's naughty-- You shouldn't be staring at a boy's spot like that--\s03」

name: Azel
message: 「Wh-What are you saying!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Azel, you're surprisingly--」

name: Azel
message: 「I am not!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Could you guys stop getting all hyped up over my crotch situation」

name: Azel
message: 「...I'm going home.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Skipping out again?」

name: Azel
message: 「No. It's the restroom.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Waaah! You're going home to the restroom?!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Has 'I'm going home' basically become your catchphrase at this point?」

name: Azel
message: 「Sigh... What a terrible ordeal...」

name: Azel
message: 「What a foolish thing to do. That's practically announcing myself as someone suspicious!」

name: Azel
message: 「Why... this uneasy feeling... refuses to stop...」

name: Azel
message: 「It really is that man...」

name: Helena
message: 「Hiii, Melilot.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Good morning, Helena. So, what business brings you here?」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh my, am I not allowed to drop by unless I have business with you?」

name: Melilot
message: 「If you're sacrificing your pre-work coffee time to come here, there must be a decent reason for it.」

name: Helena
message: 「I'm not that much of a stay-at-home, you know. Unlike a certain someone.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Did you just call me stay-at-home-sized...?」

name: Helena
message: 「Stay-at-home! Well, just as you deduced, I do have a small favor to ask.」

name: Melilot
message: 「I will consider whether to accept after hearing what it is.」

name: Helena
message: 「Geez, you're so mean!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Just state your business, please.」

name: Helena
message: 「...About Synn-chan's special training--I think the other kids are probably going to come ask you to teach them various things too.」

name: Helena
message: 「I know you don't really have the spare time for it. Still, I want you to understand how those kids feel.」

name: Helena
message: 「That resolve of theirs to stand up against Re-Crea. If they ever come to ask you themselves--」

name: Melilot
message: 「Heehee...」

name: Helena
message: 「W-What's your problem? I'm trying to have a serious conversation here」

name: Melilot
message: 「Even someone as flawless as you can misread a situation, it seems」

name: Helena
message: 「Huh? Wait, you don't mean...」

name: Melilot
message: 「It seems I made the right call not brushing them off. They already came to ask me, without needing you to tell me」

name: Helena
message: 「I see」

name: Melilot
message: 「They said the Crusaders can't stand on Sakura-kun alone, so they want to take this on together as a whole team」

name: Melilot
message: 「I had thought it was just simple camaraderie or a sense of solidarity, but」

name: Helena
message: 「I misjudged them. Those kids are growing even faster than I thought」

name: Melilot
message: 「With Sakura-kun at the center, they're expanding at a dizzying pace」

name: Helena
message: 「Maybe accelerating that kind of growth... is the true power a Demon Lord possesses」

name: Melilot
message: 「Something completely different from the power hidden within oneself. The ability to draw out the absolute maximum potential of one's allies」

name: Helena
message: 「Right, right. Then everything's smooth sailing. To think there's no need for me to step in--this year's Student Council really is a cut above the rest!!」

name: Helena
message: 「'Alright. Work 'em to the bone!'」

name: Melilot
message: 「Of course. That is precisely what I intend to do\s04」
